decision.reasoning_trace: My goal was to find a high-quality portable Bluetooth speaker, but the browsing experience was significantly hindered by the high volume of non-speaker items in the results, including storage cases, replacement batteries, chargers, and wall shelves. Among the actual speakers, the premium options like the Bang & Olufsen and Bose SoundLink are reputable but felt expensive for this session. While the INSMY Retro and DOSS SoundBox Pro+ offered interesting features at a mid-range price, I noted several reviews across the various brands mentioning durability issues after a few months of use. Combined with the disorganized selection, I didn't feel confident enough in any specific model to proceed with a purchase today.
